name: Tobirama Senju Onpiece2 theme
description: Tobirama Senju was the Second Hokage of Konohagakure and the younger brother of Hashirama Senju. He was known for his sharp mind, political prowess, and the invention of many important ninjutsu such as the Flying Thunder God Technique, the Reincarnation World Wheel, and the Shadow Clone Technique.
